slots.jd.managed-services.about:
Position summary
Brennan IT Services, a managed services provider, seeks a Junior Systems Administrator to support client infrastructure in a hybrid arrangement based in Atlanta, GA. The role maintains servers, monitoring and patching under the guidance of senior engineers. At minimum, candidates need scripting experience, familiarity with cloud platforms and a recognised systems administration certification. Preferred candidates also hold a cloud operations certification.
slots.jd.managed-services.duties:
Responsibilities
- Support capacity planning by tracking resource usage across client environments and reporting trends to senior engineers.
- Tune monitoring alerts to reduce noise and make sure actionable issues reach the right team.
- Run scheduled patching cycles for client servers and confirm systems return to service afterward.
- Document changes and follow the change approval process for all production work.
- Respond to service tickets and escalate complex incidents to senior staff.
slots.jd.managed-services.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- Required: 2 or more years of experience in systems administration or IT operations.
- Required: working knowledge of Python and Bash scripting for routine automation.
- Required: experience with Prometheus monitoring, Microsoft Azure, Terraform and Kubernetes.
- Required: Systems Administrator Certificate or an equivalent licence or certification.
- Preferred: Cloud Operations Certificate.
slots.r1.b1: Runs backup and recovery tests on Microsoft Azure, cutting the time needed to verify restores by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Prepares change approval requests for Ansible playbook updates, with a senior administrator reviewing each change before rollout.
slots.r1.b3: Coordinates patching cycles for servers managed through Active Directory, reducing missed patches by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Takes part in the on-call rotation, handling backup and recovery requests and escalating complex issues to senior staff.
slots.r1.i1: Supports change approvals at Oakmont Systems as a Junior Systems Administrator, preparing change requests for review by senior staff.
slots.r1.i2: Works as a Junior Systems Administrator at Oakmont Systems, tuning monitoring alerts so the operations team sees fewer false alarms.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level site reliability and IT operations professional with about 2 years of experience automating routine tasks with Ansible and Python. Builds Grafana dashboards and handles small, well-defined parts of the work with a senior colleague reviewing.
slots.summary.2: IT operations and site reliability professional at the entry level, with about 2 years of experience in monitoring and automation. Takes on clearly scoped tasks using Python scripts, Ansible playbooks and Grafana dashboards, with each change reviewed by a senior colleague.
